# Sushi Roll Sandviken

> Japanese sushi restaurant in Sandviken, Bergen (Stølegaten 12B). Fresh sashimi, nigiri and creative maki rolls. Table booking, takeaway and home delivery via Wolt. Also home to Kakure Omakase (https://kakureomakase.no/). Sister restaurant for takeaway in the city centre: Sushi Roll Sentrum (https://sushiroll.no/).

- Address: Stølegaten 12B, 5003 Bergen, Norway
- Phone: +47 413 34 541
- Email: post@sushirollsandviken.no
- Opening hours: Monday–Sunday 14:00–21:30
- Cuisine: Japanese, sushi

## Book and order

- [Book a table](https://booking.gastroplanner.no/sushi-roll-sandviken/t)
- [Order takeaway](https://order.gastroplanner.no/s/ZCVRJ)
- [Delivery via Wolt](https://wolt.com/en/nor/bergen/restaurant/sushi-roll-sandviken)
- [Tripadvisor reviews](https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurant_Review-g190502-d24092539-Reviews-Sushi_Roll_Sandviken-Bergen_Hordaland_Western_Norway.html)
